title: Pinocchio
source_topic: CodeChef / ACM-ICPC Asia-India Finals Mirror Contest 2016
statement: Just like the Pinocchio from the childhood classic, our Pinocchio has the worst habit in the world - lying. But instead of a prolonging nose, Pinocchio has a shrinkable memory, such that every time he lies to somebody, his memory reduces to some degree from its present capacity.
